chunks: And he was asked about the payment of the mourning woman, so he said: “There is no harm in it, and mourning was indeed performed for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.أَجْرِ: payment, compensation, or wage in this context
key_terms.النَّائِحَةِ: a woman who laments or mourns the deceased publicly
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pay a mourning woman for lamentation in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that there is no objection to the payment received by a mourning woman. It supports this ruling by citing that lamentation was performed for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.
